name: Bohonal de Ibor (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bohonal de Ibor (a castle above waves on white and blue).
history: The arms and the flag of Bohonal de Ibor were approved by the Order of 17 April 1995 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 20 April 1995, approved by the Consejero de Presidencia y Trabajo Joaquín Cuello after the municipal council's approval on 27 June 1994.

features.role: Bohonal de Ibor arms — castle above waves
